title: AgentQueueJob
description: Mirrors apps/api/src/lib/agentQueue.ts's AgentQueueJob union by hand — the two job payloads apps/api enqueues on the 'agent-jobs' BullMQ queue and apps/interview-agent's Python consumer (agent/voice/consumer.py) picks up, distinguished by BullMQ's own job name ('agent-start' or 'noshow-check').

oneOf.title: AgentStartJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued for scheduledAt minus 2 minutes — the agent prepares the room. Everything else the agent needs (candidate CV, role blueprint, question bank) it looks up from Postgres directly by these ids — see apps/interview-agent/agent/db.py.

oneOf.title: NoShowCheckJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued for scheduledAt plus 15 minutes — marks the session NO_SHOW if it never actually started (Phase 8).
